data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.widget.name
data.value: Meta embed

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.widget.description
data.value: Embeds a public Threads, Instagram or Facebook post from its URL.

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.properties.url.label
data.value: Post URL

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.properties.url.explanationText
data.value: Paste the public link to the post. Supported: instagram.com/p/… or /reel/…, threads.com/@user/post/… or /t/…, facebook.com/user/posts/… or /reel/…

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.properties.sourceType.label
data.value: Source type

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.properties.sourceType.explanationText
data.value: What the URL points to. This version supports single posts, reels and videos only.

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.properties.sourceType.options.post
data.value: Single post

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.properties.category.advanced
data.value: Advanced

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.failure.notconfigured
data.value: This widget needs a post URL. Open Configure widget and paste one.

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.failure.invalidinput
data.value: That isn't a valid web address. Paste the full https:// link to the post.

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.failure.unsupportedinput
data.value: That URL isn't a supported Threads, Instagram or Facebook post link. Supported: instagram.com/p/… or /reel/…, threads.com/@user/post/… or /t/…, facebook.com/user/posts/… or /reel/…

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.failure.notfound
data.value: Meta can't embed this post. It may be private, deleted, or not embeddable.

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.failure.rejectedbyprovider
data.value: Meta rejected this URL as not embeddable.

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.failure.transient
data.value: Couldn't reach Meta right now; the embed will appear once the service responds.

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.failure.unexpectedmarkup
data.value: Meta returned markup this widget doesn't recognise. Update the package or report it.

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.failure.internal
data.value: Embed failed; see the event log.

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.properties.category.appearance
data.value: Appearance

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.properties.layout.label
data.value: Layout

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.properties.layout.explanationText
data.value: Natural keeps Meta's own width and left alignment. Centered keeps the width and centers the embed in the column. Fluid stretches Facebook posts to the column width; Instagram and Threads embeds are already fluid up to 658px.

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.properties.layout.options.natural
data.value: Natural

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.properties.layout.options.centered
data.value: Centered

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.properties.layout.options.fluid
data.value: Fluid

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.properties.hideCaption.label
data.value: Hide caption

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.properties.hideCaption.explanationText
data.value: Instagram only. Hides the post caption under the media. Ignored for Threads and Facebook.

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.properties.theme.label
data.value: Theme

data.name: xperiencecommunity.metaembeds.properties.theme.explanationText
data.value: Threads only. Light or dark styling of the embed. Ignored for Instagram and Facebook.
